name: Cmb.Tech N.V.
summary: Cmb.Tech N.V., a Belgian firm specializing in maritime transport, was founded in 2003 and maintains its headquarters in Antwerp. The company, previously known as Euronav NV, officially adopted the name Cmb.Tech NV in October 2024. Its operations are structured across three key divisions: Marine, H2 Infra, and H2 Industry. The Marine segment maintains and deploys a diverse fleet, encompassing vessels such as crude oil tankers, bulk carriers, container ships, chemical carriers, offshore wind support vessels, tugboats, and ferries. The H2 Infra division focuses on sourcing and developing sustainable molecule supplies, alongside the production and distribution of green hydrogen and ammonia. Concurrently, the H2 Industry division delivers adaptable industrial applications utilizing dual-fuel systems. Cmb.Tech N.V. functions as a subsidiary of CMB NV.
